About

Turning data into

I'm a growth marketer with 5+ years of experience across B2B SaaS, healthcare, and D2C, working with global US MNCs and international teams. I sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and technology — building programmes that don't just look good but actually move numbers.

Currently at WebMD | Medscape, I manage end-to-end campaign delivery for enterprise pharma clients including Merck, AbbVie, and AstraZeneca, while simultaneously building AI agents using Gumloop and Google Enterprise to automate workflows and scale team capacity.

I'm actively building toward roles in growth marketing, product marketing, and AI-driven demand generation — and open to relocation globally including Finland, Singapore, the UK, and the US.
